vectors.name: foreground subagents finish, run, or are cut by the turn's end
background subagents end with their completion, the session, or keep running past turns
a stopped subagent continued by a message is one subagent with two runs
rows of the older lanes: transcript lines and hook pulses
a rewind hides the abandoned branch but keeps the subagents that ended there
a clear wipes earlier subagents; a recalled message no longer anchors a rewind
artifacts: published, updated, opened, failed, uploaded, and from a subagent
repeated rows and calls batched in one message
